summary: AMETEK filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an unsecured senior notes offering, with principal amount, coupon and maturity left blank pending pricing. Proceeds, together with concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and commercial paper used to fund the roughly $5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, which closed August 26, 2026 under a May 5, 2026 purchase agreement. Notes rank pari passu with senior unsecured debt and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase obligation. Joint book-runners include BofA Securities and J.P. Morgan. Routine debt financing, not a new special situation; watch pricing terms and leverage.
